# ADR-0003: Deny overrides grants and geographic eligibility

Recorded: 11 October 2026. Retrospective project decision; not a bank governance approval.

## Status

Accepted and implemented in fixture policies

## Context

A customer can permit a recipient entity but forbid the country where that entity stores data.

## Decision

Intersect entity eligibility, country policy, dataset/field restrictions, purpose, consent and entitlement. Explicit exclusions win. Unknown or failed OPA decisions deny the affected operation.

## Alternatives

Entitlement alone; country permission alone; permissive handling of missing policy.

## Consequences

A logically entitled recipient may receive nothing. Never send denied candidate payloads just to discover rejection remotely; record those decisions at source.

## Evidence

poc/policies/federation.rego; poc/policies/operational.rego; poc/policies/migration.rego

## Gate

Rego, browser parity and actual database tests must agree on permitted fields and forbidden destinations.
